name: Revenue.io
description: Revenue.io is a Salesforce-native revenue execution platform combining dialing, sales engagement, conversation intelligence, real-time coaching, forecasting, and AI. It captures calls, emails, messages, meetings, and sales insights in Salesforce so revenue teams can work from their CRM system of record.
agentUseSummary: Revenue.io documents provider-operated Salesforce, email, calendar, Zoom, and Teams connections plus three Guided Selling automation methods exposed inside its licensed Salesforce managed package through Apex and Flow. It does not publish a supported external Revenue.io authentication, endpoint, schema, webhook, or application-registration contract for third-party workspace access, so Relay does not capture Revenue.io, Salesforce, Google, Microsoft, or Zoom credentials, automate private product surfaces, call non-public APIs, or expose agent actions.

providerSetup.blocker: Revenue.io does not publish an externally callable third-party API with an application authorization and distribution contract, endpoint and schema reference, or webhook contract. Its documented automation methods are public Apex and Flow actions inside a licensed Guided Selling Salesforce managed package, and its API key and secret are issued by Revenue.io implementation staff for that package's org-bound server connection rather than third-party use.
providerSetup.nextAction: Reassess only if Revenue.io publishes a stable external third-party API with explicit authentication, permissions, endpoints, schemas, distribution terms, revocation, webhooks where applicable, and bounded non-communication reads suitable for Relay.

evidence.supports: Official product material identifies Revenue.io as a Salesforce-native platform for dialing, engagement, conversation intelligence, coaching, forecasting, AI, and automatic CRM activity capture.

The official documentation directory exposes Guided Selling Complete Participant Action, Skip Participant Action, and Create Quick Action under Salesforce Administration API Endpoints, alongside provider-operated integrations, but provides no external Revenue.io developer platform or third-party authorization contract.

Official release documentation describes the Guided Selling automation methods as a public Apex method and Flow-compatible actions that run inside Salesforce, rather than externally callable Revenue.io REST endpoints.

Official setup documentation states that an Implementation Manager or Support generates an API key and secret tied to the customer's Salesforce Organization ID so the Guided Selling package can communicate with Revenue.io servers; these are not third-party developer credentials.

Official installation documentation requires a Salesforce administrator, a managed-package URL supplied by Revenue.io staff, admin-only package installation, and approval for the package to communicate with Revenue.io servers.

Revenue.io's official agreement limits use to purchased subscriptions and published documentation, prohibits seeking non-public APIs and incorporating Revenue Products into another offering, and identifies its Google and Salesforce connections as provider-operated integrations.

Official privacy material describes processing account credentials, CRM records, calls, recordings, transcripts, SMS, email, calendar, contact, and AI-derived data, reinforcing the decision not to automate private surfaces or capture credentials without a bounded supported external contract.
